title: Dependency security updates
summary: Security updates to the libraries MyAPES Account is built on, with no change to how the app works.
changes: The Laravel framework, the Symfony components and the Markdown library MyAPES Account uses are updated to versions with the latest security fixes.
The tools used to build the app's styles and scripts are updated to versions with the latest security fixes.
version_rationale: Patch: dependency security updates within their current major versions, with no new feature and no change to routes or behaviour.
validation: composer audit and npm audit report no advisories; the full test suite, the frontend tests and the frontend build passed locally; the Laragon preview served the app on the updated libraries.
rollback: Deploy v0.61.0 with deploy-cloudron.yml; this release adds no database migrations.
provenance: Milestone v0.61.1 Beta: Dependency security updates, epic #763 with issue #764, pull request #765.
